newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo down after cautious broker comment.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo down after cautious broker comment.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc dropped on Thursday as cautious comment from analysts at BZW prompted profit-taking in the stock, which has risen sharply in recent months, market sources said.

Glaxo shares were down 20p at 12.57-1/2 stg by 0838 GMT in volume of 4.1 million shares. After rising strongly through the early months of the year they hit a record 12.99 stg in mid-May -- up some 37 percent since the end of 1996.

BZW cut 100 million stg off its current-year pre-tax profit estimate to 2.72 billion stg and was cautious on the short-term outlook for the stock, though from 1998 onwards it remained positive on the stock, sources said.
Analysts at BZW were said to have attributed about two-thirds of the downgrade to costs of launching a new over-the-counter anti-smoking product, which was expected to eat into second-half margins.
The rest was blamed on the continuing strength of sterling, sources said.
Analysts at BZW could not be reached for comment.
